Energy proportions are aggregated into broad categories:


Scope 1 energy categories

• Biogenic fuels: include all solid, liquid and gas biomass fuels

• Fossil fuels: include all solid, liquid and gas fossil fuels used in on-site

   combustion.

• Other: Include use of municipal solid waste, renewable heat (not

   including CHP), and other unspecified energy sources.


Scope 2 energy categories

• Electricity (Standard): is grid electricity. This can include renewable

  energy supplied through the grid, depending on the supplier

  location, or individual power purchase agreements.
